    Hi, I'm Abhijeet.

    I'm a first-year engineering student at Cambridge Institute of Technology in Bengaluru. I got interested in computers and ended up spending far too much time making things on them.

    Most of what's on this site started as "this would be cool if..." and turned out harder than planned. I like that part. You stare at something for twenty minutes, change one line, and it finally works.

    I'm working towards full-stack development, with a lot of curiosity about AI and automation.

    The best way to learn how something works is probably to try building a slightly worse version of it.
